in_marathi.name: Pranavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Motion of Prana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pranavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pranavi means 'Motion of Prana'. Prana is the life force which is present in every living being and is responsible for the functioning of the body. Pranavi is a name which is believed to be full of life and vitality.

vedic_reference.note: The name Pranavi comes from the Sanskrit word 'pranav', which is a syllable in Vedic chanting and is believed to represent the sound of the universe's creation. The name Pranavi is derived from this root and signifies the one who bestows life and nourishment.
